stem.text: Chlorofluoroalkanes have been used as the refrigerant in refrigerators but care has to be taken in disposing of old refrigerators.
Which statements about chlorofluoroalkanes are correct?

items: $\text{C–Cl}$ bonds more readily undergo homolytic fission than $\text{C–F}$ bonds.
Care is taken in the disposal of old refrigerators because of possible ozone depletion.
